claims.label: Company overview
claims.value: Develops, manufactures and delivers flexible sealing solutions for cable and pipe penetrations.
claims.excerpt: Roxtec develops, manufactures and delivers flexible sealing solutions for cable and pipe penetrations.

claims.label: Modular cable and pipe transits
claims.value: Modular-based transits for cable and pipe sealing, providing certified protection against risks including fire, gas and water.
claims.excerpt: Roxtec modular-based transits are used for cable sealing and pipe sealing in numerous demanding industries and projects worldwide as the seals provide certified protection against multiple risks, including fire, gas and water.

claims.label: Multidiameter™ adaptable sealing modules
claims.value: Multidiameter: sealing modules with removable rubber layers that adapt to the outside dimension of the cable or pipe.
claims.excerpt: is based on sealing modules with removable rubber layers and allows for a perfect sealing, regardless of the outside dimension of the cable or pipe.

claims.label: Roxtec ES — EMC shielding seals
claims.value: Roxtec ES seals provide electromagnetic shielding (EMI/EMP protection) as well as certified protection against fire, gas and water.
claims.excerpt: Roxtec ES seals provide electromagnetic shielding as well as certified protection against fire, gas and water.

claims.label: Shielding against wiretapping and emissions
claims.value: Electromagnetic shielding can protect sensitive information from wiretapping or contain disturbances generated by power generation.
claims.excerpt: You can protect sensitive information from wiretapping or keep disturbances generated by power generation inside a shielded area to ensure emission limits.

claims.label: Roxtec software suite (Transit Designer™)
claims.value: Software suite for design, drawings, certificates, installation, quality checks and mandatory documentation of cable and pipe transits.
claims.excerpt: The Roxtec software suite simplifies work with everything from design, drawings and certificates through to installation, quality checks and mandatory documentation.

claims.label: Engineering tool with 50,000+ users
claims.value: Free online engineering tool used by more than 50,000 users worldwide.
claims.excerpt: There are already more than 50,000 users around the world that benefit from this free, online engineering tool.

claims.label: Super stainless steel components
claims.value: Super stainless steel components included in the standard product portfolio for extreme environments.
claims.excerpt: We include super stainless steel components in our standard product portfolio.

claims.label: Offshore wind
claims.value: Offshore wind: cable entry sealing, cable management and vibration damping, including turbine foundations (monopile, jacket, suction bucket and floating foundations).
claims.excerpt: Roxtec provides offshore wind farms with an all in one solution for cable entry sealing, cable management and vibration damping.

claims.label: Seals for floating and fixed turbine foundations
claims.value: Cable and pipe transits for all kinds of turbine foundations, including floating foundations.
claims.excerpt: Use them for monopile foundations, jacket structures, suction bucket foundations and floating foundations.

claims.label: Power grid & HVDC installations
claims.value: Fire- and IP-rated seals for HVDC converter stations, AC substations and transformer rooms.
claims.excerpt: Use them to secure HVDC converter stations, AC substations, transformer rooms and GIS as well as medium and low voltage areas.

claims.label: Marine & shipbuilding
claims.value: Shipbuilders and ship owners specify Roxtec transits to seal around cables, metal pipes and plastic pipes.
claims.excerpt: Shipbuilders and ship owners all over the world specify Roxtec transits to seal around cables, metal pipes and plastic pipes.

claims.label: Manufacturing
claims.value: Serves manufacturers and end-users across industries.
claims.excerpt: Roxtec solutions enable high quality for both manufacturers and end-users.

claims.label: Published customer case: tidal turbine
claims.value: Roxtec's marine page lists a customer success story about sealing a tidal turbine (Orbital Marine Power, Scotland). This is a published customer reference, not a partnership with any Blue Science Park company.
claims.excerpt: Sealing the world's most powerful tidal turbine

claims.label: Sustainability performance (EcoVadis, CDP)
claims.value: Reports EcoVadis Gold and an improved CDP score (B rating).
claims.excerpt: We increased our global CDP scores to a B rating.

claims.label: Global reach: 80+ markets
claims.value: Serves and supports cable and pipe seal users in more than 80 markets.
claims.excerpt: serves and supports cable and pipe seal users in more than 80 markets

claims.label: Certified, tested safety products
claims.value: Positions its sealing solutions as the most tested and certified in the industry.
claims.excerpt: Roxtec provides the most tested and certified sealing solutions in the industry
